name: Corvera
long_description:
Corvera (YC W26) is the context layer for AI-native CPG brands. We help brands unlock the full potential of AI by making their unified data legible to any AI tool via MCP. 

As of mid-March 2026, we scaled from $0 to $33k in MRR in 4 weeks, are serving 12 brands, and are growing 130% week-on-week.

With Corvera in place, brands can enable anyone in their organization to:
- Rapidly deploy AI agents via tools such as Claude and ChatGPT,
- Build dashboards and apps using Cursor and Lovable, and
- Automate workflows across the entire business, from category management to supply chain.

All in a secure, audit-logged, and access-controlled environment, without the need for a team of data engineers or AI specialists, in a simple plug-and-play solution.

We're founded by Chris (2x Founder; ex-CEO at Better Nature; Forbes 30U30), Dirk (ex-Google Data & AI Lead), and Matthew (ex-Head of Product at Rosemark; Princeton MEng in CS).

To-date, we’ve raised $6.2M and are backed by YC, firstminute capital, 6 Degrees Capital, 20VC, Rebel Fund, Duke Capital Partners, and more. Our ICP are omnichannel retail-focused CPG brands at the $100M+ revenue inflection point.

Our mission is bold: to enable the next generation of unicorn CPG brands to be run by teams of less than 10 people. 

Our vision is even bolder: to be the system of intelligence for the $5.4T global CPG industry.

Visit www.corvera.ai to learn more!

launches.title: Corvera 🛒 | AI agents for CPG brands
launches.tagline: AI agents that automate retail brand ops and increase profits by 40%
launches.body:
Hey, we’re [Chris](https://www.linkedin.com/in/cwnkong/), [Dirk](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dirkbreeuwer/) and [Matthew](https://www.linkedin.com/in/itsmcollins/) - cofounders of Corvera!

# **TL;DR**

Corvera is the AI agent workforce for CPG back-office. We help retail brands increase profits by up to 40% by deploying digital workers that run their operations. 

**Ask:** Looking for intros to CPG brands that sell into retail, ideally with > $50M in ARR. Direct them to our website to schedule a demo!

**Website:** <https://www.corvera.ai/>

**Book a demo:** <https://www.corvera.ai/schedule-demo>

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o5ZLvv9Cgro>

### **The Problem**

Retail CPG brands are drowning in operational debt.

* **Ops is a massive opportunity cost** – US CPG brands waste 40% of their time and spend $78bn managing supply chains when they should be getting their products out there and selling to more customers.
* **Poor ops is a huge growth bottleneck** – CPG founders typically stem from product, marketing, or sales backgrounds. Therefore, ops handled by non-ops founders = distraction, pain, and time wasted on non-value-add tasks.
* **Ops pain scales with the brand –** Ops debt and headcount grow as a brand serves more customers, launches more products, and operates in more geographies, further hampering the brand’s growth.

### **The Solution**

**Corvera is the fully autonomous command centre managing ops for fast-growing retail brands.** 

We help brands cut wastage, improve margins, and maximise revenue, with an AI workforce that knows exactly how CPG brands work. We automate the 3 core ops workflows which consume the most time and hamper growth:

**1) Sales Order Processing**

_Process orders end-to-end without lifting a finger._\
\
Corvera plugs into your existing tools and automatically processes sales orders end-to-end, from fulfillment to invoice. It parses email PDFs and text, matches them against known entities in our catalogue, and executes downstream actions with human-in-the-loop approvals.

**2) Inventory Management**

_Track inventory across every location in real time._

Corvera knows exactly where your stock is and how much you’ve got at all times. We seamlessly sync inventory data across all of your warehouses, track shipments and transfers, and suggest actions to rebalance stock across your estate to maximize short-term revenue.

**3) Demand Forecasting & Supply Planning**

_Forecast demand in real time and automatically process purchase orders to prevent stockouts._

Corvera learns from your sales history and, coupled with insights from your team, forecasts demand in real time. With full visibility of your inventory across all locations, Corvera suggests corrective actions to prevent stockouts, so you can maximize your revenue, keep your customers happy, and accelerate your growth. \
\
**In short:** We take away ops pain from CPG brands, allowing them to do what they do best - market and sell their products to their customers. 

### **The Team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96996&key=user_uploads/3038174/4e3af8f4-816c-4f7e-bb27-9a529803d966)

From Left to Right:

[**Dirk Breeuwer**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dirkbreeuwer/) (Co-Founder & CTO)

Formerly Data and AI Lead at Google with 6+ years of experience. Led Google’s marketing AI transformation, incubating five AI systems, including a multi-agent workflow automation that improved brand compliance review efficiency by 90%.

[**Christopher Kong**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/cwnkong/) (Co-Founder & CEO)

2x Founder, Forbes 30U30, formerly CEO of Better Nature - one of Europe’s fastest-growing and largest meat-free brands, active in 6 countries and sold in 5,000+ retail stores. Closed every major sales deal and led every fundraise.

[**Matthew Collins**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/itsmcollins/) (Co-Founder & CPO)

Ex-CPO at Rosemark, an AI-powered B2B data analytics and marketing platform, and scaled the Computer Science department at Eton College, the UK’s most prestigious boarding school. A Princeton grad with an MEng in CS. 

[**Berk Güngör**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/berk-g%C3%BCng%C3%B6r-35196a14a/) (Founding Engineer & Head of AI Engineering)

AI/ML Engineer with 6+ years of experience, focused on applied LLMs and real-world AI automation. Holds an MSc in AI from the University of Hamburg. An all-round beast and an incredible asset to the team - we’re lucky to have him.

### **What We’re Looking For**

**Introductions to CPG retail brands with >$50M of revenue.** We’ve got a product that’s ready to go. Keen to meet as many CPG brands as possible between now and demo day!

### **Get In Touch**

Contact us: [founders@corvera.ai](mailto:founders@corvera.ai)

Bood a demo: <https://www.corvera.ai/schedule-demo>
